verdict.rationale: ADK's official docs include a dedicated guide for 'Exposing ADK Tools via an MCP Server' — building an MCP server that wraps ADK agent tools so they're accessible to any MCP client — which is the mechanism for connecting to an ADK-built agent via MCP [google-adk-docs-5][google-adk-docs-18]. However, this is a how-to/pattern for developers to build their own server rather than a turnkey, pre-hosted official MCP endpoint, and the surrounding evidence mostly emphasizes ADK-as-MCP-client (docs-4), not a first-party managed server. Missing for 10: a documented first-party hosted/managed MCP server endpoint or independent confirmation of a working out-of-the-box server, rather than just a build-your-own guide.
